policy.closure_minimum: A reviewer-approved nonempty source commit and tangible before/after, tests and independent evidence; code_verified never means E2E accepted.
policy.r0_completion: Every pre-R0 finding has reviewed closure AND final 32 case live browser/model/n8n/physical Markdown/reload/replay with four final SHA auditors. Deferred G13 is a separately tracked future delivery gap, not an excuse for R0 architectural blockers.

workstreams.title: Audit mode and scope accuracy
workstreams.existing_owner: Agent supervisor and existing four roles
workstreams.change_contract: Distinguish diff review from whole-repo scans; record honest coverage and require pinned immutable source.
workstreams.verification: Negative documentation-only diff with known pre-existing source defect; four roles independently assert scope.

workstreams.title: Source semantic coverage/provenance
workstreams.change_contract: Remove candidate-shape and semantic max-8 constraints, retaining authenticated evidence, bounded memory/resources, provenance and no invented relation.
workstreams.verification: 0/1/N and N:M facts, >8 references, ambiguous/hallucinated names refused, physical readback.

workstreams.title: Typed relations and complete groups
workstreams.change_contract: Interpret arbitrary source group through AI, verify existing Core canonical memberships, no hard-coded Person/2–8/grammar handling.
workstreams.verification: 0/1/2/3/5/9+ typed groups, cross-actor and unknown members safe pending, E3/Tasks replay.

workstreams.title: Generic owner of facts
workstreams.change_contract: P4 carries Core-selected natural canonical owner, without Day/SELF-only semantics.
workstreams.verification: R31 positive P4→correct Markdown owner→Notes; arbitrary NoteSchema type, ambiguous/unknown owner negatives.

workstreams.title: One E2 context shared across active stages
workstreams.change_contract: No P4 history reset; exact original source, actor, bounded history, timing and evidence go to relevant blocks unchanged.
workstreams.verification: R32 and mixed multi-turn; verified actor isolation, no history-derived write privilege.

workstreams.title: Registered App operation composition
workstreams.change_contract: No fixed Core→Tasks, Events→Tasks, or CREATE-only branch in generic coordinator; Apps enforce only own rules.
workstreams.verification: F22 mixed Work Sessions; create/edit/cancel/query, synthetic third App, partial receipts, no premature writes.

workstreams.title: TaskCorePlanner boundary
workstreams.change_contract: Remove Task-specific construction of generic Person facts without losing assignee/parent/work-session policy.
workstreams.verification: Generic links to arbitrary Note types, ambiguous owner and replay negatives.

workstreams.title: Language and semantic routing without keyword lists
workstreams.existing_owner: LLM typed plan + Temporal evidence + App ports
workstreams.change_contract: Replace event keyword/finite multilingual date lexical routing only when equivalent source provenance and time bounds are proved.
workstreams.verification: Paraphrased read/mutate Event, date qualifier omission negative, no source word-specific production branch.

workstreams.title: Calendar occurrence generic projection
workstreams.existing_owner: Calendar typed occurrence contract + Event adapter
workstreams.change_contract: Calendar projects arbitrary registered occurrence types, Event lifecycle stays in Events.

workstreams.title: One thin coordinator (no parallel semantic engine)
workstreams.change_contract: Consolidate P4 and legacy dispatcher after dual-run parity; delete redundant routes not move them to another file.
workstreams.verification: 32 full-source cases, mixed 0/1/N, replay, source/N:M, owned writes, bounded performance, four final SHA auditors.

workstreams.title: Historical and competing-path retirement
workstreams.existing_owner: Core module owners + E3 canonical Writer
workstreams.change_contract: Prove inactive callers, optional launches and tests; archive/delete only if not a distinct security boundary or user-supported path.
workstreams.verification: Import/feature flag/test caller inventory, no direct Markdown writer outside Core/E3, regression before deletion.

workstreams.title: Mobile device-local delivery target
workstreams.change_contract: Do not confuse Raspberry DEV with installable offline mobile. No scope creep into R0 base simplification.
workstreams.verification: Separately reviewed offline-first mobile acceptance, not used to accept R0 or silently forgotten.
